description: This file implements the DeviceInfo class and related functions for retrieving device information such as serial number, SKU, make, device type, model name, year, firmware version, capabilities, and supported features like HDR, Atmos, CEC, HDCP, and EDID. It interfaces with device info and capabilities through external interfaces and manages internal state with thread safety.

classes.name: DeviceInfoLink
classes.description: Singleton class managing device information retrieval and capabilities, interfacing with device info and capabilities interfaces, providing thread-safe access to device properties and features.
